abstract: This article first introduces the theoretical knowledge of psychology in more detail, analyzes the psychological process of college students, introduces some basic knowledge of psychological evaluation and mental health, and fully analyzes the needs and framework for de veloping this platform and description. The platform uses object-oriented technology to develop the entire system, mainly using QSL and Python technologies. The core technology used is the data mining clustering algorithm-k-means algorithm, which is used to distinguish groups of students with different types of psychological problems. The results showed that the psychological recovery rate increased by 7.3%, and the platform application rate was 97.2%.

articleTitle: Neural Computing and Data Fusion Modeling Analysis of the Index System of China's Industrial Modernization Level
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this paper, the basic theory of neural network introduces the basic concept, development process and application of neural network, analyzes the basic working principle of the network and the relationship between neural network and pattern recognition, and qualitatively demonstrates the basic mechanism of neural network fusion recognition. On the basis of discussing the connotation of current Chinese industrial modernization, a set of 23 specific indicators including industrial system construction, production system construction. The level evaluation index system reveals the regional differentiation characteristics of China's industrial modernization development level. The characteristics of multi-source data have the characteristics of high dimensionality and the shortcomings of the network in solving such problems. Several improved methods of network learning algorithms have been studied.

articleTitle: Application Strategies in the Safety Management of Power Containers under the Power Smart Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This article comprehensively uses the Internet of Things technology, uses various Internet of Things devices to determine the real-time status of the power container to determine the parameter extraction process, and establish a power easy intelligent security system based on the Internet of Things technology, comprehensively using the Internet of Things radio frequency identification and sensor technology. Realize the intelligent monitoring, warning and temperature adjustment of the operating environment of the box substation. This system is mainly composed of remote control system, STM32 real-time control system, data collection system and data processing system, and fuzzy adaptive PID control system. The remote control system is mainly for remote monitoring and remote control; the STM32 control system is mainly responsible for coordinating the data collection system and the data processing system, and communicates with the remote control system through the network.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Intelligent Attendance Management System for Smart Campus
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Digital attendance management system has found to be extensively efficacious in monitoring and tracking the entry of students and staffs in an organization. Conventional method of taking attendance is considered chronophagous and prone to errors. The authors pen down an ingenious method of taking attendance precisely and accurately using machine learning. The authors also make sure about the vulnerability of the system towards a larger group of students. The students will be tracked while going in and out of the classrooms. The systems is instilled with a Haar cascade for appropriate detection of the face. The faces are further recognized using Local Binary Pattern Histogram algorithm. The tkinter GUI interface is used for user interface purposes in the system. The attendance status of the students can be checked on logging with a personal user ID and password.

articleTitle: Big Data Mining Algorithm Based on Semantic Segmentation on Heterogeneous Multi-Core Platforms
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of accurate big data mining with multi-core heterogeneous boards, a semantic segmentation-based method for accurate big data mining with multi-core heterogeneous boards is proposed. The fuzzy information detection model proposed in this paper for constructing big data with multi-core heterogeneous boards based on semantic segmentation improves the feature matching model of data mining by nearly 7%. Construct a feature matching output model for big data with multi-core heterogeneous boards, and use semantic segmentation algorithm extraction methods for feature extraction and statistical analysis of big data with multi-core heterogeneous boards. Establish a semantic dynamic feature analysis model for big data on a heterogeneous multi-core platform, and extract statistical features of big data on a heterogeneous multi-core platform.

articleTitle: Radial Basis Function Networks for Image Restoration with Stochastic Normalizations as Bayesian Learning in Deep Conventional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The objective of the image restoration process is to improve the high-quality visual resolution from degraded images using various techniques in Artificial Intelligence., utilizing a normalization method, a method of centers and weights that has been adapted from the Radial Basis Function Network (RBFN) is initiated to the Stochastic Normalizations method as a Bayesian Learning algorithm. The normalized form of the RBFN-SB algorithm is derived, and the RBFN input data vector is from a damaged image array raised using Taylor's expansion. Following the dynamics of the normalized technique appeared to be tactful in comparison with the RBFN-SB. The test performance comparable to BN and, concomitantly, better validation losses suitable for ensuring results unpredictability estimation through approximate Bayesian posterior are procured. To test the outcome of the proposed system gave speed up the learning process, with minimum mean squared error (MSE) and produced better results of restoration images from damaged images. In the same form, the normalization accuracy can also be improved notably by the Bayesian learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Retracted: Intelligent Transportation Planning System Based on Urban Network Topology Modeling and Remote Sensing Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This article first studies the road general route planning problem, analyzes the urban road dynamic road network model modeling problem. Proposes a multi-path planning algorithm based on urban network topology modeling, and establishes bus network transfers and stops the two network models describe the practical significance of each feature parameter of the network model mapping the complex public transportation network. And choose the conventional public transportation network of remote sensing data analysis as the research sample, starting from the two aspects of bus transfer and bus station, establish the bus transfer network model and bus station network model.

articleTitle: Garment Stock Trading Digital System Development with PHP Laravel and Bootstrap Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper discusses the creation of a web portal for persons who work in the garment industry and want to register as a buyer or a vendor. This web portal includes a user-friendly interface for vendors to update their stock lists and a purchasing system for buyers. This web portal reduces the amount of time spent on the selection and purchase of ready-made clothing. Transactions are initiated via a digital card and online payment, and goods transit is secure and can be maintained timely. This web portal system facilitates the trade of garment products in a more efficient and effective manner. The traditional method of trading ready-made clothing products has been replaced by a new strategy that incorporates an online stock lot service system. This web gateway was developed with the PHP Laravel and Bootstrap frameworks.

articleTitle: Research on the Antioxidant System of Oxytropis Glabra Poisoning on Male Animals Based on Computer Aided Analysis: From the Perspective of DNA Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: From the perspective of DNA data mining, this article analyzes the effects of Oxytropis vulgaris poisoning on the antioxidant system of male animals based on computer-aided analysis, and reveals the poisoning mechanism of Oxytropis glabra to male animals. The results showed that compared with the normal control, the number of red blood cells (RBC), hematocrit (HCT), hemoglobin (HGB), mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration (MCHC), total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), super Oxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px), catalase (CAT) activities decreased significantly, total cholesterol (T-CHO), triglycerides (TG), malondioxide Aldehyde (MDA), low-density lipoprotein (LDL) and very low-density lipoprotein (VLDL) levels all increased significantly.

articleTitle: Retracted: Dynamics of Photography Guiding Based on Multi-angle Virtual Image Reconstruction Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In order to explore the design of ultra-high-speed photography guiding rotating mirror, a systematic theory and method of dynamic performance design of rotating mirror is proposed. Combining statics and dynamics theories, and on the basis of 3D virtual reality technology, an image reconstruction algorithm is constructed to realize image reconstruction based on multi-angle virtual image reconstruction technology and 3D virtual reality technology. Use finite element analysis software to perform numerical analysis on static strength, modal, harmonic response, and natural frequency sensitivity of the rotating mirror originally designed, and test the results of the numerical analysis. The experimental results show that the image reconstruction method based on 3D virtual reality technology The quality of the reconstructed image obtained is higher.

articleTitle: A Review of Opportunistic Routing Protocols on Various Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: A thorough comparison of opportunistic routing protocols is essential for deciding the proper routing strategy for diverse opportunistic network applications. This study looked at the effectiveness of EPIDEMIC, Spray and Wait, Prophet, Prophet-Snw, Simbet, Simbetts, and Bubble-Rap routing protocols. This empirical study makes use of the Adyton simulator. This study compares the results of predicting the behaviour on Delivery Probability, Average Delay, and Overhead Ratio using various mobility models, along with real-world mobility traces having different buffer sizes. Simbetts outperformed all other protocols in practically all cases, according to the simulation.

articleTitle: A Study on Importance of Blockchain Technology in Logistics Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Blockchain is a decentralized data storage network where information is stored in a cryptographically secured block and maintained by a public ledger to protect against any alteration. This has been popularly used in financial systems but also has huge potential in other sectors such as health, smart city, and logistic. The supply chain logistic system is essential for whole management, starting from the raw material of industries until the last consumer delivery. This logistic management is faced with challenges such as transparency, delay in orders, lag in the information updating, multiple data entries. These can be diminished with this scattered technology. So, this article gives an overview of decentralized data storage networks by blockchain technology and their evolution and importance in logistics/supply-chain management. This article aims to traverse viable use of this scattered computing and its importance in supply chain logistics management.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automobile Sales Management Information System Based on C#.NET Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Sales determine the survival and development space of an enterprise, and the vitality of an enterprise is more directly reflected in the sales performance of the enterprise, which is of significant significance to the improvement of an enterprise's core competitiveness. This thesis is based on the design and implementation of a sales management system based on C#.NET built by an automobile sales service company as an enterprise prototype. It can achieve effective management of sales information, improve sales efficiency, and reduce sales costs; organically integrate sales information with logistics information and other departmental information to improve the company's information management level; combine the .NET framework and B/S structure to design multiple modules Sales management system efficiency increased by 6.5%

articleTitle: Design of DC-DC Converter based Self Balancing Segway Transporter for Indoor Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The intention of this research is to survey the features of self-balancing transport. It works on the principle of turning circle at numerous rates to stop the driver from stumble above period control. Steadying of two-wheel vehicle is a demanding task for humans. To overcoming this, two-wheel balancing vehicle with DC converter and DC batteries has been designed. This vehicle has one dais and two wheels on the sides. A helmsman is fixed to the body of Personal transporter who controls the vehicle steering. The superiority of the vehicle is that produced zero emission, zero turning radius and safe travelling speed. This type of Segway is more effectiveness and accessible knowledge in the field of electrical people in habitual life.

articleTitle: Species Wise Classification of Crust Leather images based on histogram equalization
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The classification of Crust leather on various animal species is one of the sorting processes in leather production. At the Industry under the sorting process, segregation of Crust leather on the basis of the type of leather made on Hides from Cattle, Buffalo and Skins from, Goat and Sheep. This process is normally does by a team of experts through manually and it consumes good amount of time. Hence, authors have proposed a new dataset namely INT_LEA_IMG_CLRI_UNOM with 609 images consisting of Training and Testing dataset. The images are pre-processed using filters such as LAPLACIAN, MEDIAN, SOBEL, ROBERTS, SCHARR, PREWITT, GAUSSIAN and the image enhanced by employing of Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). Features are extracted using Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Histogram. Further features are selected through Random Forest and Support Vector Machines. Classification accuracy is confirmed at significant level of the proposed method using Naïve Bayes classifier at 94 % level of accuracy. Hence current study confirming this method will be complement to the sorting process while segregation of Crust leather on the basis of the type of leather made on Hides from Cattle, Buffalo and Skins from, Goat and Sheep.

articleTitle: Urban Public Art Communication Algorithm based on Smart Virtual Cloud Platform and Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The image of the city is an important factor of the city’s culture, including the city’s historical origins, spiritual beliefs, social features, and morphological characteristics. As a more prominent and direct means of expression in the image of a city, public art not only symbolically expresses and records the self-deduction of the city, but also an important medium for city publicity and marketing. In the context of multicultural collisions, how should to construct and maintain a distinctive city image? How to give full play to the true value of public art. This article analyzes the effective communication of public art media in the construction of urban image from the perspective of communication science as high as 98.2%.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Orthodontics - An exposition
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: For centuries, dentistry has become the most essential part of human life. Tooth is the robust and strongest part of the human body. Poor dental hygiene leads to bruxism. Artificial Intelligence is the upcoming technology that makes a tremendous change in the field of dentistry. To avoid the randomness in error and missing data, AI has taken many initiatives for the development of healthcare industry. The development of Artificial Intelligence has further classified as strong AI and weak AI, which aroused after the implementation of mathematical and statistical concepts. The AI concentrate on the study, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of the problem that happens in teeth and gums. Of the study, major dental problems are considered to be periodontal diseases. This affects both the teeth and gum, which may further affect the rest of the healthy teeth. This study focuses on the major dental issues and the algorithms which is highly useful in the detection by early diagnosis of the dental related problems.

articleTitle: Review of various Image Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: One of the easiest ways of communication is possible through interpreting wide range of images on various applications. It is the non-structural data that does not have clear semantics. Image mining techniques implemented on the images are used to extract features/train the real time systems. This can be achieved using combination of various algorithms of image processing, machine learning and artificial intelligence. This paper discusses about those image mining techniques and the challenges faced by various researchers.

articleTitle: Use of Nanotechnology Sensors for Sustainable Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Nanotechnology is considered as a leading technology in controlling the agricultural process through monitoring with its miniature dimension. It therefore paves way for essential benefits on enhancing the quality and quantity of foods, reducing the input required for agricultural production, full utilization of soil nutrients, etc. The challenges in these models include availability of natural resources, sensing proper nutrients from the soil for crop-specific production, cultivation of crops. Hence, in this paper, various nano-sensors are utilized to increase the crop productivity by analyzing the nutrients present in the soil. The accuracy of acquisition and detection enables what type of crop can be used for cultivation or irrigation. The real-time nano sensors are deployed for absorbing the elements present in the soil that should suit the productivity of crop. The results of simulation using a deep learning detector based on the input from nano-sensors show an improved rate of productivity than state-of-art models.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Signal System of Coriolis Mass Flowmeter Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the Coriolis flowmeter signal enhancement and frequency estimation method of deep learning and the calculation method of Coriolis flowmeter signal time difference based on discrete Fourier transform and sliding Goertezl algorithm. According to the characteristics of Coriolis flowmeter signal, a Coriolis flowmeter time-varying signal model based on random walk model is proposed. The proposal of the model and the research on its related signal processing methods. The signal enhancement and frequency estimation methods of the direct HR adapti ve spectral line enhancer are used, and the implementation of the algorithm under the time-invariant and time-varying signal models are respectively given.

articleTitle: Counterfeit Drug Detection System with Multi-Layered Check and SCM using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: 10% of drugs in the world are counterfeits and 200 billion dollars are wasted on counterfeits. These counterfeit drugs not only contain toxic doses but also cause poisoning that leads to death. Using these drugs, not only reduces the treatment of contagious health problems but also increases disease progression that leads to fatal. This project produces accurate results about counterfeit drugs and the usage of drugs if it is not counterfeit. Using Optical Character Recognition (OCR) check of medicine, the check requires the minute details and then determines whether the medicine sold is genuine or not. So, they can get the percentage of how genuine the drugs are. By doing this project, one could help people by making them aware of a counterfeit drug that they have purchased.

articleTitle: Research on Coriolis Mass Flowmeter Signal Processing and Driving Method
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: In this paper, the digital signal processing method and driving method of Coriolis flowmeter are studied. Three digital signal processing methods of Coriolis flowmeter are mainly studied: the method based on digital phase-locked loop, the method based on quadrature demodulation and the method based on the method of adaptive Funnel filter and sliding Goertzel algorithm; stiffness algorithm, bubble compensation algorithm, and dual-mode compensation algorithm of the Coriolis flowmeter sensor according to the simulation model; write the upper computer program to realize the real-time monitoring and parameter modification of the measurement data; the stiffness algorithm and The compensation algorithm is tested experimentally. The experimental results show that the stiffness algorithm can track the changes in the stiffness of the measuring tube, and the compensation algorithm can significantly improve the accuracy of the Coriolis flowmeter when measuring gas-liquid two-phase flow.

articleTitle: Retracted: Visual Saliency Analysis of Artistic Photography based on Single-Angle Image Reconstruction Algorithm with Attention Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of existing visual saliency models that do not have universal applicability, this paper analyzes the visual saliency Is model based on single-angle image reconstruction. In order to solve the problem that the saliency of the IS model is not ideal when describing large targets, this model is used the method is simple, the amount of calculation is small, and the feasibility is good. The similar area is assigned a similar saliency value as a constraint. The engineering algorithm needs to downsample the original image. The saliency map is only the original image. The algorithm has high computational efficiency and the output saliency map It is the full-resolution algorithm that avoids image segmentation, so the effect is very good for images that are difficult to automatically segment.

articleTitle: Retracted: Functions and Ways of Computer Information Technology in Optimizing Library Operation and Management Considering Massive Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, the application of computer information technology in various fields has become more and more extensive, and the world is entering the information age. The development and application of information technology has brought new opportunities and challenges to library management. This article combines the concept of library information technology, analyzes the challenges of library management under information technology, and then proposes the practical application of information technology in library management, and reviews in detail the research status of the massive data mining process and Faced with challenges, and discussed the processing mode in the process of massive data mining from the perspective of game theory, granular computing model and big data processing thinking.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Soft Gripper for Human Interactive Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Body ache is one of the major problems faced by old people. Manual body massage is a common remedy for pain relief. To automate the process of comfort and physical relief, a gripper is needed. There are many types of grippers available, but they are very hard in nature and are not suitable for direct human contact. The proposed work presents a soft gripper to provide light pressure for relaxing the muscles and for relief from body pain. A three-dimensional (3D) mould is manufactured using a FabX 3D printer. Liquid Silicone Rubber (LSR 110) A and B resin mixture is made to set using the 3D mould to fabricate the soft gripper. The control of tentacles is done using Arduino UNO and pressure sensor details are monitored to find optimal pressure required to hold and lift the objects. The experimental result shows that the gripper control is easy and it is suitable for human interactive robots.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Application of Intelligent Speech Recognition Technology in Physical Training
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and artificial intelligence algorithms, sports and sports-related teaching are not improving in a spiral shape. Among them, intelligent video extraction technology and intelligent speech recognition technology are the most widely used. In this paper, based on PCA, LDA and other data dimensionality reduction algorithms, the application of intelligent speech recognition technology in physical education is studied. After studying the feature extraction, the speech and semantic recognition technology improves the recognition of sports actions by 8%, and the results are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Computing and Speech Recognition Technology in University Golf Smart Guidance
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Golf teaching plays a key role in promoting the development of golf and promoting the development of students' physical and mental health. Therefore, it is of great significance for undergraduate colleges to develop golf teaching activities, and curriculum design is an important content and necessary prerequisite for the development of golf teaching. Based on cloud computing and speech recognition, this article briefly introduces the development and curriculum design of golf teaching, and analyzes the existing problems and effective strategies of golf teaching curriculum design in current undergraduate colleges. The results show that distributed cloud computing makes golf smart the efficiency of guidance increased by 7.6%.

articleTitle: Leveraging Human Segmentation Guided Frames in Videos for Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) has been an essential task in Machine Learning for identifying the concurrent activity through some form of sequential data like in video frames or activity sensors. This research provides a framework, working on video data, that aids the use of an independent deep learning pipeline working on human image segmentation for pre-processing each passing video frame sent into a Convolutional-LSTM HAR pipeline for determining the ongoing activity. The applied pre-processing makes the foreground pixel intensities lower than that of the human subject making the subject appear in better focus. The applied novel pre-processing technique enhances the results compared to ones using standard RGB frames sent to the conventional HAR pipeline. The work is then validated over two publicly available datasets, namely: KARD and MSR-Daily Activity. The results show some superior accuracy compared to other state-of-the-art works over the validated datasets with accuracy as—99.07% (KARD) and 98.75% (MSR-Daily Activity).

articleTitle: Sports Nutrition Intervention for Athletes Based on Continuous Image Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of weak anti-noise ability, incompatibility of signal size and insufficient feature extraction in athlete sports nutrition intervention based on deep learning, a recognition method based on continuous image deep learning is proposed. Firstly, the time-varying signal is reconstructed into several continuous image frames to ensure that the input size is consistent; then a low-rank decomposition algorithm is designed to separate the key motion information annihilated by noise; at the same time, a depth model of time domain and spatial domain information fusion is proposed, Automatically capture the spatio-temporal characteristics of variable-length image sequences, and verify the proposed method on WiAR datasets and autonomously collected datasets. Experimental results show that the average recognition accuracy of the proposed method is 0.94 and 0.96, respectively, and has high accuracy and robustness in universal scenarios.

articleTitle: Digitalization and Centralization of Medical Information and Patient History in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Some remote area samples are reviewed through both online response and physical survey, where the parameters and specific keywords constructed and novel updated data samples of the conducted survey regions are focused. Through the conducted survey and processed novel dataset, the percentage of dominant demographics common health issues, their treatment locations, their further treatment of doctor suggested treatment locations, the origination capabilities of physical medical documents, and many other parameters are concluded. This survey generated a decision where the larger demography expressed their recurring need to visit remote doctors and medical centers for treatment. Different sections of our survey report concluded that while visiting these remote medical centers, they have often failed to organize their medical history documents. These reports solidify the need for a digital patient history database and the centralization of this database for ease of access from any location or medical center, or doctor’s chamber. Our project has also shed some light on the software and technical architecture that could be the foundation of a centralized database for patients’ medical history.

articleTitle: Ensemble Learning using Vision Transformer and Convolutional Networks for Person Re-ID
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Person Re-Identification is the process of recognizing a targeted individual across multiple views at different times, in different and challenging real-life diverse settings. It remains a conundrum due to the significant amount of intra-class variation present in same individual caught across different cameras. Most of the existing models require a large amount of data for training, as a result of which they do not generalize well on small datasets and hence decreases the robustness of the identification process. To reduce this variance, this paper introduces an end-to-end triple stream ensemble model making minimal changes in the Vision Transformer, Resnet50 and Densenet121 architectures respectively. Our model performs well on the Market1501 dataset achieving an accuracy of 90.05% and 80.45% on the Duke MTMC ReID dataset.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics on Covid-19 Prediction using ResNets
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Corona virus acute disease, a life-threatening condition, emerged in 2019. In December 2019, the virus was discovered for the first time in Wuhan, China, and has since spread throughout the world. This paper proposes using Residual Neural Networks (ResNets) to predict COVID-19, where the input is collected from Internet of Things (IoT) network. Using a system designed to combat a newly emerging infection in its early stages, this paper tackles the problem. In addition to tracking confirmed and reported cases, the system also keeps tabs on cures and deaths daily. This was done so that all parties involved could see the devastation that the lethal virus would cause as soon as possible. Using RNN and GRU in an ensemble, the RMSE value has been computed for various cases such as infected, cured, and dead. The results of simulation shows that the proposed ResNets for classification is effective in predicting the covid-19 cases than the other existing deep learning models.

articleTitle: Wireless Vehicle Control with Speed Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: A robot is a mechanical device, which is controlled by computer and electronics programming. Several advanced robots have been built, and they are now in use in factories all around the world. This research study attempts to design a new upturned ROBOT, which can be controlled with the use of an Android application. Furthermore, the Bluetooth messages are utilized to communicate between the Arduino UNO and android device. The Bluetooth module can be connected to an Arduino via the UART protocol. The robotic motion can be skilled when responding to command obtained from android device. Finally, it is observed that the developed robot gives steady output, as well as its quality and repeatability, unrivalled. The process of automation helps to know about reprogrammed conditions and it gets switched out to provide numerous applications.

articleTitle: Simulation Environment for Autonomous Cars using Location Data and Embedded Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Training an autonomous vehicle in a perfect environment where all traffic rules are followed, and all road marking are present is a well-researched area. However, there is a significant difficulty in training an autonomous vehicle in a densely populated environment. The proposed system aims to predict the steering direction of an autonomous vehicle in an area where traffic rules are often violated, and road marking are often absent by training the autonomous vehicle using user hand gestures.

articleTitle: Retracted: Application of Data Association Mining Technology in Chinese International Online Guiding Platform Considering Complexity of Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Based on complex data mining, all frequent itemsets are obtained by using the complete itemset prefix tree. According to the calculated confidence and support, the strong association rules of Chinese and international languages are extracted from the frequent itemsets, and the security of compressed language data is considered., further processing the set of strong association rules to obtain the set of candidate rules, MOOC discussed in the existing major educational technologies, pointed out that the core positioning of the global Chinese online communication service platform is to aggregate high-quality teachers and teaching resources for international Chinese education, thereby attracting Existing and potential Chinese students enter.

articleTitle: Cloud Storage and Authenticated Access For Intelligent Medical System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) and smart diagnostic implants have improved medical systems by allowing remote access and screening of patients' health conditions from any time and location. Medical IoT devices monitor patients' health and collect data into medical files, which are then saved in the cloud and reviewed by doctors for decision-making.When it comes to data sharing and outsourcing on the Cloud, however, the security and privacy of electronic health records are key concerns. To guarantee security and privacy in a smart healthcare system, this research presents an efficient data storage and access control system. This article adds three layers of security, including a password, a deep learning enabled psychometric slot, and a deep learning-based evaluation. The proposed method has been put to the test, and the results show that it is viable when compared to existing access control schemes.

articleTitle: Dual Server Construction using Double Encryption
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The inner keyword attack happens when keywords are not entered with high entropy and meaningfulness, which leads to easy guessing and eradication of the semantic security of most keyword searching schemes. To avoid these attacks, the keyword search security mechanism known as public-key encryption and the security models are proposed. A single server does not has the competence of finding out the similarities between keywords. Henceforth, this research study analyzes how far the security models are efficiently used for searching attacks, and proposed novel security mechanisms to define all the aspects of security models and develop novel methods to avoid keyword guessing attacks.

articleTitle: Study on Incident Detection and Management of Vehicular OBD Data on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: A majority of the research on accident detection systems involves increasing the precision at which it can be detected. This approach proposes a test-bed for a vehicular incident detection system that uses real time data collected from OBD -II port of automobiles and later passed on to Edge devices within vehicles to detect an accident or other rash driving behavior patterns. Machine learning algorithms are developed and deployed onto edge devices like Jetsonnano for real time pattern recognition. Once an incident like accident or rash driving is triggered, the data is cached and written onto Inter Planetary File Systems (IPFS) a distributed file storage system and put onto Ethereum Blockchain for later analysis and documentation by various stakeholders like police, RTO, law, forensic team etc. Blockchain acts as an immutable ledger providing proof of all incidents. Further using the obtained data, dashboards of the incident can be generated for further visualization and understandability to the concerned stakeholder

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Literature Survey on Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The electrical infrastructure are experiencing over burdening due to exponential growth in the power demand. In recent years, centralized power generating units losing interest due to more T&D loss, limitation in the expansion of generating capacity, poor ATC, environmental concerns etc. The efficient use of RES and their proper integration to the existing infrastructure plays key position in the entire augmentation of the network performance. Dispersed/distributed generation is part of the load is supplied by generating power at load premises to reduce the burden on the network by relieving the over loading on the electrical infrastructure. In this paper, the different types of DG, uses and benefits of DGs, Indian scenario, DG technologies and different optimization techniques exercised for DG placement and their limitations are discussed.

articleTitle: Application of Internet of Things Technology in Power Terminal Communication Access Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper introduces the Internet of Things technology and makes full use of the perceptual advantages of the Internet of Things at the end of the network to realize the seamless connection of the sensor network, the terminal communication access network and the backbone network. It studies the mobile terminal security access authentication method combined with fingerprints, Data level and command level fusion secure exchange bus technology, machine learning-based smart whitelist technology and network transmission strategy dynamic adjustment method, and put forward innovative ideas that fit the current production and operation of power companies based on the above key technologies, and improve power information The ability to pre-check safety hazards can realize continuous empowerment of safety technology.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Intelligent Monitoring System Based on BPNN and Convolutional Hierarchical Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper proposes a mathematical model of an intelligent monitoring system composed of a combination of BPNN neural network and convolutional hierarchical analysis algorithm. Using the advantages of neural network, genetic algorithm overcomes the defect that neural network is easy to fall into local minimum error. Using the reconstruction feature based on lifting wavelet to determine whether the dynamic process is abnormal, the BPNN based on the reconstructed mean feature divides the five abnormal patterns into three categories. The three types of abnormal patterns are further identified by LSSVM based on the reconstructed shape features. The numerical simulation of MATLAB shows that the monitoring of various parameters in the well through the monitoring model has remarkable predictive ability, good real-time performance, powerful learning function, and an increase of 9.7% in accuracy, which has strong practicability.

articleTitle: The Voice Recognition System Based on The Prediction and Anomaly Detection of the Individual Income Tax of College Students under the New Tax Law
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of my country's fiscal and taxation system reforms, my country's personal income tax collection for salary payment has undergone tremendous changes, making the personal income tax collection for salary payment more scientific and reasonable. If you want to better enjoy the content of this policy, carry out tax payment. Planning research is very necessary. Based on the speech recognition system and the background of the new tax law reform, this article analyzes the basic theories and methods of personal income tax payment and tax planning, and proposes the tax forecast and abnormality detection of student income tax under the new tax law reform. The results show that abnormalities are reduced by 7.6%.

articleTitle: Development of a Web Based Online Financial Aggregator Service
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Based on the joint realization of financial technology and search algorithms, an online banking aggregation service was developed. A large database containing all data from participating financial institutions and precise search algorithms is the primary key behind the specific aggregation results. Users, regardless of occupation, position, or age, need to handle bank accounts, credit cards, and loans for different purposes. Using this algorithm, users can find the most suitable option for them.

articleTitle: Machine-Learning Based Approach to Predict Energy Consumption of India States
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Energy is a vital component of economic development, and its availability is intimately tied to a country's progress. Economic development implies rising levels of energy consumption since energy is necessary to carry out the industrial process. A precise estimate of energy demands could be important in making smart power generation and buying decisions. The impact of energy on many sectors is insufficient. Energy is what propels and sustains economies. Energy from the industrial sector continues to be a boon to all economies, whether developed and developing. Its forecast has been recognized as a key requirement for national and international viability. This study reveals about the prediction of energy consumption which uses Random Forest a machine learning algorithm, that displays the predicted value on the GUI screen based on the input given by the user.

articleTitle: Impact of Using Electricity for Rural Warehouse Moisture Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: There are many warehouses in our country. They do not have any calculation and track record of their warehouse's electricity cost and humidity. If they have access to their temperature, amplitude, volt, they can calculate the cost of their warehouse. Even though they have no idea about their warehouse humidity, that is why they sometimes face a large amount of loss. In this case, this is a massive problem for the store owner. Most of the people of our country are using an android operating system based mobile application. So, an android based phone and IoT based solution can solve this project's problem. If the owner can calculate their warehouse unit of electricity, they can make a massive profit from this. They reduce the losses and also save their products. The impact of using electricity for rural warehouse moisture control systems has opened a new era of modern warehouse systems. It is based on the IoT and is intended to make it easier to measure and regulate temperature and humidity. Using this warehouse humidity control system makes it possible to store and recover large amounts of crops without interruption. Our research for this project makes the model very easy to use and low cost. Though Bangladesh is an agricultural country, its economy and significant rural jobs depend on agriculture. However, there is a lack of moisture control system technology and knowledge in rural areas. For this, 33% of crops are spoiled every day using a manual moisture system. In this project, a modern moisture control system model using NodeMCU and DHT-11 sensor has been presented. The main goal of this project is to help the rural farmers in our country to save their valuable crops & give assurance to control humidity by using our projects. For this, our country will enrich foods and fulfil its internal demand. Besides, crops, seeds, and foods from different crops can be exported and earn much foreign exchange.

articleTitle: Retracted: Construction Of an Auxiliary System for Smart Online Courses Based on Shared Screen Technology and Face Verification
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The design principle of the intelligent education management system based on face recognition described in this article is the collaboration of artificial intelligence and teachers. The camera captures student video information once in 30s and sends it back to the server where the algorithm is located. Screen sharing includes screen image acquisition, encoding, decoding, and transmission. Processes such as display and display belong to the field of streaming media information processing and transmission. Use multi-task convolutional neural network to perform face detection on images, and apply face recognition technology to classroom attendance and student status monitoring to improve the quality of student learning and form a human-computer Collaborative decision-making model.

articleTitle: Development and Realization of the Psychological Counseling Platform for Colleges in the Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This article first introduces the theoretical knowledge of psychology in more detail, analyzes the psychological characteristics of college students, introduces some basic knowledge of psychological evaluation and mental health, and fully analyzes the necessity of developing this platform and description. This platform uses object-oriented technology to develop the entire system, mainly using ASP.NET and AJAX technology. The core technology used is the clustering algorithm of data mining—k-means algorithm, which is used to distinguish groups of students with different types of psychological problems. The results show that psychological recovery has increased by 7.3%.

articleTitle: FPGA based Silicon on Chip using Flexible Digital Pre-Distortion for Software Defined Radio Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Reconfigurable FPGA based silicon on chip is designed using flexible digital pre-distortion for software defined radio transceiver in this proposed system. In the Silicon on Chip (SoC) platform the Flexible Digital Pre-distortion (FDP) is implemented along with the generation of real time baseband signal. The model named recollection multinomial constructed FDP explanation is realized for linearization of Radio Frequency (RF) Power Amplifiers (PA) here which makes system more cost effective and dynamic. On basis of the gain and phase coefficients of the Look Up Tables (LUT) the power amplifier behavior is identified. The non-linear coefficients are extracted using memory polynomial model. Therefore the non-delayed normalized mean square error can be achieved through the calculation of system performance and the LUT coefficients are updated. Finally the pre-distorted signal is generated for software defined radio transceiver.

articleTitle: Prescriptive and Predictive Analysis of Intelligible Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Nowadays, large quantities of data may not be able to handle by the traditional big data analytics. Organizations / Companies started to realize the seriousness of data flying to generate the right decision and backing their strategies. The internet, digital production and social network are constantly increasing. The term "Big Data" represents companies digital data and to the entities that are characterized by large volume, velocity and the variety. This article defines the concepts, importance, technologies and applications of Big Data analytics.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Big Data Analysis Platform for Rural Tourism Planning Based on ENVI and CUDA
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Based on ENVI and CUDA, this paper studies the design of a big data analysis platform for rural tourism planning. Aiming at the problems of large calculation tasks, low analysis efficiency and long development cycle in the tourism data analysis process, a set of large-scale toursim based on CUDA is designed and implemented. A framework for parallel analysis of communication network log data. Compared with traditional CPU serial analysis, the efficiency of a single node in processing log data analysis can reach a speedup of 15-20 times. Based on the ENVI technology platform, this paper preliminarily establishes a set of rural tourism planning big data evaluation model from pertinence and operability; and through the value evaluation of rural tourism planning service functions, it provides guidance for the development and protection of collaborative planning.

articleTitle: Retracted: Characteristic Model Mining Algorithm of College Students’ New Media Literacy Behavior under the Background of the Internet Data Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: This paper studies the characteristic behavior mining of college students' new media literacy in the context of Internet data retrieval. First of all, this article defines the four concepts of media, network media, network media literacy, and college students' network media literacy, the application of data mining technology in Internet information retrieval, and the use of the Jess network algorithm to correlate related data. It also explained the content composition of college students' network media literacy and the importance of cultivating college students' network media literacy. Analyze the dual impact of new media on college students’ behavior and the reasons for college students’ behavioral anomie under this background; finally, a simulation analysis of examples is carried out on the basis of Bayesian algorithm.

articleTitle: Application and Optimization of ARIMA Model and BP Neural Combined Model in the Prediction of Population Aging
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: After entering the 21st century, the problem of population aging across the country has become increasingly prominent, which has brought severe challenges to the regional social security system. In view of this, based on the combination model of ARIMA time series and BP neural network, the future trend of population aging during the "13th Five-Year Plan" period is predicted on the basis of an in-depth analysis of the current situation of national aging. The results of the study show that the national population aging problem has become a bottleneck for economic and social development, and the number of elderly people and their proportion in the country will show a significant increase in the next five years. Finally, a number of policy recommendations were put forward based on the research conclusions, and the results showed that the accuracy of the prediction results of the ARIMA and BP neural network combined model increased by 9.7%.

articleTitle: Dynamic Key Management based ACO Routing for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Ant Colony Optimization is applied to design a suitable and shortest route between the starting node point and the end node point in the Wireless Sensor Network (WSN). In general ant colony algorithm plays a good role in path planning process that can also applied in improving the network security. Therefore to protect the network from the malicious nodes an ACO based Dynamic Key Management (ACO-DKM) scheme is proposed. The routes are diagnosed through ACO method also the actual coverage distance and pheromone updating strategy is updated simultaneously that prevents the node from continuous monitoring. Simulation analysis gives the efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Application of Information Display Platform in English Online Cloud Data Transmission Considering Data Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the current needs of teachers and students of colleges and universities and the society for English learning content, this paper studies the necessity of constructing an English online cloud data transmission platform, and makes a general plan for the construction of the information platform. In English teaching, cultivating an information display platform that considers data efficiency is also one of the main teaching goals of college English. Therefore, an overview of the network information platform and English pragmatic competence are first given, and then explore the factors that affect English pragmatic competence and the importance of improving students' pragmatic competence.

articleTitle: Mobile Terminal Body Temperature Monitoring and Management System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: Designing a wearable dynamic body temperature monitoring system that uses Bluetooth to wirelessly transmit data is the objective of this paper. It has the characteristics of wireless, wearable and dynamic monitoring. It uses NTC sensors and Bluetooth 4.0 protocol. It is composed of body temperature monitoring terminals, mobile phone clients and cloud service platforms. It consists of three parts. In the design and testing part of the wearable body temperature measurement system, the software and hardware design of the body temperature sensor terminal, wireless receiving terminal and burning test board based on the negative temperature coefficient thermistor are introduced. A wearable assembly method for the body temperature sensor is proposed. The measurement error of the temperature sensor based on NTC is analyzed and a batch calibration method is proposed. The number of contacts between medical staff and patients with infectious diseases was reduced by 7.1%, and the risk of medical staff from contracting diseases was reduced by 6.5%

articleTitle: Development of Android Application and Website to Combat Criminal Activities
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: With crime rates increasing gradually all over the world, there is an increasing demand for resources needed by the citizens, law enforcement and emergency services of a country. On many occasions, the amount of response-time and knowledge of these criminal activities can prove to be life-saving. With personal safety and intervention of crime in mind, this paper describes a system that can be implemented to decrease crime rates. The system involves an Android mobile application and a corresponding website, which is designed to help people who are in need of immediate help. It can be used by the citizens to seek help immediately in case of an emergency and help the law enforcement officers to tackle crime more quickly and easily. The system can deliver the exact location in coordinates to the closest law enforcement officer in a matter of seconds without the need of a call center representative. The goal of this research is to make help available to people whenever it is needed.

articleTitle: Compute Query and Document Similarity using Explicit Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: There is a lot of data and information that exists all around us. With the increase in data around us, it is essential to find a way to retrieve and organize the data in an efficient manner. Using generic search engines would not be the best use case for domain specific data. Thus, customized search engines based on different domains are required. The submodule used in the search engine like spell checkers can be used in various other real-world problems like grammar correction in documents and so on. In this paper Natural Language Processing based technique is proposed to achieve efficient and accurate information retrieval. It calculates nDCG scores based on several analyses such as Spell Check, Information Retrieval, Query Autocomplete. The IR System in this paper reaches a nDCG score of 0.32. Since the concept space of the Semantic Interpreter is spanned by only 100 articles. It is mainly focused to compute scores based on the query being entered and results in the form of a graph.

articleTitle: Retracted: Real-Time Monitoring of Fitness Exercise Heart Rate Based on Shared Storage and Embedded Motion Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th International Conference on Computing Methodologies and Communication (ICCMC)
abstract: The real-time heart rate value can reflect a person's heart activity ability at that time, and then measure the health of the human body from the side. This article is based on shared storage and distributed cloud computing for big data mining and analysis, real-time heart rate analysis of fitness athletes, measuring the attenuated light reflected and absorbed by human blood vessels and tissues, and using embedded motion recognition to study the capture of fitness movements with heart rate detection. To trace the pulsation state of the blood vessel and measure the pulse wave. The easy-to-wear measuring device has gradually become the main method for measuring blood oxygen, pulse and heart rate under non-hospital conditions.
